name: ERES
band_note: mean of blouse entry $445 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13); hand-band (swim and lingerie house; resortwear reads True Luxury)
why: Women's swimwear, lingerie, resortwear and loungewear made by a Paris studio, swim pieces mostly $235–$375, sold through its own boutiques, website and department stores.

quote.q: Impeccable cuts, exclusive materials, and custom-made color palettes : each piece is designed to embrace the body and offer unparalleled freedom of movement.

opview: “Impeccable cuts, exclusive materials, and custom-made color palettes : each piece is designed to embrace the body and offer unparalleled freedom of movement.” — ERES (house), The House of ERES, eresparis.com

facts_read.source: brand site (The House of ERES, Winter 2026, Iconic styles); ERES recruiting profile on Welcome to the Jungle; Journal du Luxe 2017-04-27; FashionNetwork 2014-11-20; neimanmarcus.com search; Vinted catalogue page; TRR designer index; B Lab directory; GOTS database

price_read.sublines: ERES resortwear (shirts, trousers, dresses, shoes); EXCLUDED: swimwear and lingerie (its core), loungewear/sleep, cover-ups, sarongs, pouches, hats

doors.note: Locator (stores.eresparis.com, Stores/Partners filter) lists 38 US points: 4 ERES boutiques (Beverly Hills, East Hampton, Palm Beach, South Coast Plaza) + 34 partner stockists (Bergdorf Goodman, Four Seasons/resort shops, Luisa Via Roma NYC, specialty lingerie) = wholesale, not counted. No ERES NYC boutique listed. States not published; derived from ZIP.

notes.fabric: no fabric dials (ruled 15 Oct): swim and lingerie house
notes.tech: Thread proposed 2 (2026-10-14): Peau Douce (house polyamide/elastane jersey, also used in swim). Seated as proposed, pending ruling.
notes.craft: Thread proposed 3 (2026-10-14): A 50-year house with its own Paris pattern-making and prototype studio, and long-standing French lace, embroidery and silk suppliers described by place and founding date — but none is named, and no product page says where the garment is made. More than country-on-page, less than owned making: 3. Seated as proposed, pending ruling.

tech_evidence.names: Peau Douce (house polyamide/elastane jersey, also used in swim)
tech_evidence.share: 2 of 78 sampled (Oda, Dao); the swim range uses it widely

craft_evidence.owned: partial — a Paris design and prototype studio at 19M (the Chanel-founded métiers d'art building) with pattern makers and technicians; production not stated (/19M.html)
craft_evidence.makers: none by name — 'the last lace makers of Calais-Caudry', a bobbin-lace workshop in Le Puy-en-Velay (since 1860), a northern French embroiderer (1937), a Lyon silk manufacturer (1956) (/theartofcraft.ht
craft_evidence.mills: none by name; fabric origin per product on ~1 in 4 sampled pages ('The fabric was made in Italy / China / Belgium / France')
craft_evidence.madein: 0 of 78 state where the garment was made; 21 state where the fabric was made
craft_evidence.heritage: 'For over fifty years' (/ThehouseofERES.html); lingerie line since 1998
craft_evidence.process: partial — studio prototyping and fit testing described; making not described
craft_evidence.reasoning: A 50-year house with its own Paris pattern-making and prototype studio, and long-standing French lace, embroidery and silk suppliers described by place and founding date — but none is named, and no product page says where the garment is made. More than country-on-page, less than owned making: 3.
